title: Understanding the Grouping
text: To fill in blank A, think about how you can group the data to calculate the mode for each activity type. Which column should you use for grouping?

title: Using the Groupby Function
text: The groupby function is used to split the data into groups based on some criteria. In this case, you want to group by the 'activity' column to calculate the mode for each activity type.

title: Identifying Missing Values
text: For blank B, consider which column you need to check for missing values. Which column are you trying to impute?

title: Using the isna() Function
text: The isna() function is used to identify missing values in a DataFrame. You need to apply this function to the 'hour\_of\_visit' column to find the rows with missing values.

title: Selecting the Correct Column
text: For blank C, think about which method you need to use to select the rows with missing values. How do you filter a DataFrame based on a condition?

title: Using the loc Method
text: The loc method is used to access a group of rows and columns by labels or a boolean array. You need to use this method to select the rows where 'hour\_of\_visit' is missing.

title: Assigning Replacement Values
text: For blank D, consider which column you need to update with the replacement values. Which column are you imputing?

title: Updating the DataFrame
text: You need to update the 'hour\_of\_visit' column with the replacement values for the rows where it is missing.
